scripts.dev: bun scripts/publication.ts init && bunx vercel@62.1.0 dev
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.build:vercel: bun scripts/publication.ts init && bun scripts/assets.ts && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outdir dist/function
scripts.deploy: bun scripts/publication.ts require-catalog && bunx vercel@62.1.0 deploy --prod --yes
